title: The Snowbound House
author: Lila Hart
pages: The promise is that within this quiet space you can find a steady, gentle comfort that remains even when everything else feels uncertain.
A soft sigh escaped the walls, as if the house itself whispered, "You are safe here; let the snow outside be the only thing that moves."
Beyond the window, the world was white, yet inside a single breath could stir the air, reminding you that even stillness can hold a pulse.
The lamp flickered, casting a thin line of gold that seemed to hold the room together, a quiet promise that warmth could linger even in the cold.
